verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the MCP server documentation saying the platform's hiring lifecycle extends through "offer approvals", which implies Workable has some offer approval step. The requisitions endpoint shows requisitions exist but says nothing about routing job openings through approvals before posting. Missing for 10: documented configurable approval chains (approvers, order, conditions), approval gating for job openings before they go live, evidence that offers are blocked until approved, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, job openings and offers route through configurable approval chains before anything goes live or gets sent

citations.quote: It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
